US President Donald Trump, right, and Ultimate Fighting Championship CEO Dana White attend a UFC event in Newark, New Jersey, on June 7, 2025 [AFP]By Al Jazeera Staff and ReutersPublished On 8 Nov 20268 Nov 2026
Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) chief executive Dana White has said he will meet with Donald Trump after the US president offered him the job of White House press secretary.
Speaking at a new conference after a boxing event in London on Saturday, White said he would meet with Trump at the White House on Monday to discuss the president’s offer.
Recommended Stories list of 3 itemslist 1 of 3Trump orders DOJ to investigate Democrats for ‘threatening’ peoplelist 2 of 3Who is Hakeem Jeffries, the Democrat poised to become House speaker?list 3 of 3How did AIPAC-backed candidates fare in the US midterm elections?end of list
“Dana will be a Press Secretary like none other,” Trump wrote on Truth Social earlier on Saturday. “Dana, please take the job!”
Trump also requested that White “bring with him assistants, even though some are not from our Country”.
Trump listed and posted pictures of six current and former UFC title holders to join White: Islam Makhachev and Khabib Nurmagomedov from Russia’s Dagestan region; Americans Justin Gaethje, Daniel Cormier and “Kayla Harris”, likely a reference to Kayla Harrison; and Amanda Nunes, a Brazilian who became a US citizen last year.
“We need these people to defend us against the Lunatic Left,” Trump wrote.
The White House press secretary role has been vacant since Katie Zacharia’s tenure ended ‌last ⁠month after just five days.
Zacharia succeeded Karoline Leavitt, who stepped down from the role at the end of August.

Vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, as seen from Musandam, Oman [File: Stringer/ Reuters]By Al Jazeera StaffPublished On 8 Nov 20268 Nov 2026
The United States military’s Central Command (CENTCOM) has announced a plan to block Iran’s land-based supply routes, expanding its months-long naval blockade of Iranian ports in the Strait of Hormuz.
CENTCOM, which oversees US military operations in the Middle East, announced on Saturday that it had established a new task force “to prevent Iran from using ground routes to transport advanced weapons and other materials”.
Recommended Stories list of 3 itemslist 1 of 3Qeshm island and Hormuz hit, as mediators try to prevent US-Iran escalationlist 2 of 3External parties using Iraq to launch attacks on neighbours: Iraqi FMlist 3 of 3Iran’s IRGC says building underground sites for weapons production, storageend of list
Task Force Iron Gate will reinforce “the success of our ironclad blockade against Iran at sea”, CENTCOM Commander Admiral Brad Cooper said.
Based in Tampa, Florida, the task force will coordinate with other US government agencies “on preventing the movement of advanced weapons systems, dual-use technologies, sanctioned materials, and illegal revenue streams across Iran’s land borders and the Caspian Sea”, CENTCOM said.
Michael Mulroy, a former US deputy assistant defence secretary for the Middle East, told Al Jazeera the task force’s role will be to find out where “weapons systems are coming in, how they could potentially be cut off”, and how “Iran is transporting its energy”.
He added that if US President Donald Trump orders an escalation to the war, it will likely be attacks on this “series of targets”.

Migrants wait to be transferred to a Temporary Reception Centre for Foreigners (CATE) after disembarking from a Spanish coastguard vessel at the port of La Restinga, on the island of El Hierro, Spain, on November 6, 2026 [Jesus Cabrera/Reuters]By Al Jazeera Staff, AFP and ReutersPublished On 8 Nov 20268 Nov 2026
Authorities of El Hierro, one of Spain’s Canary Islands, have declared an emergency and asked the government in Madrid for help after a surge in migrants and refugees arriving on boats.
“We are very concerned… by this sharp increase in arrivals,” Alpidio Armas, head of the governing council for El Hierro, one of Europe’s main entry points for migrants and refugees from West Africa, told Spanish television on Saturday.
Recommended Stories list of 3 itemslist 1 of 3More than 140 dead, missing on refugee boat stranded off Mauritanialist 2 of 3Pope Leo’s visit lays bare Spain’s tangled politics of faith and migrationlist 3 of 3Five killed, dozens more feared dead in boat adrift off Canary Islandsend of list
“This is precisely what has led us to declare an emergency in order to ensure a framework of cooperation with higher-level institutions.”
More than 3,300 people have arrived on the island in about 30 boats since the start of November, according to local authorities. El Hierro has about 11,400 residents.
Officials are seeking temporary accommodation for the new arrivals, while conditions at the island’s hospital have become “undesirable”, Armas said.
The situation is “absolutely unsustainable”, the Reuters news agency quoted Fernando Clavijo, the regional leader of the Canary Islands, as saying on Friday.

Real Madrid's Kylian Mbappe scores his team's third goal [Jose Jordan/AFP]By AFPPublished On 7 Nov 20267 Nov 2026
Kylian Mbappe scored for the seventh match running as Real Madrid pulled provisionally level on points with La Liga leaders Barcelona after a 3-0 win at 10-man Valencia.
Reigning champions Barca visit Atletico Madrid, third, on Sunday, aiming to move back clear of the chasing pack.
Jose Mourinho’s Madrid largely dominated at Mestalla Stadium on Saturday, securing an eighth win in a row across all competitions.
Federico Valverde and Arda Guler’s first-half goals put Madrid in the driving seat, and Mbappe added a third in the second half.
Los Blancos were without winger Vinicius Junior, who was serving the final game of a four-match ban.
Madrid have thrived in his absence, putting heavy pressure on Barca, whom they beat in the Camp Nou Clasico on October 25.
In the ninth minute, the match stopped for players and fans to pay tribute to Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel, who tragically died on Tuesday.
Madrid goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois made a smart save to deny Aaron Mayol, who had picked Aurelien Tchouameni’s pocket in a dangerous area.
Valencia’s Guido Rodriguez had a goal disallowed for offside before Mourinho’s side took control.
Valverde drilled Madrid ahead from outside the area after Mbappe’s free kick was blocked by the Valencia wall and fell to the Uruguayan.
Guler soon doubled the lead after Jude Bellingham’s cross was deflected kindly into his path.
Guler had a good chance for the third early in the second half, but Valencia goalkeeper Stole Dimitrievski grabbed the ball as the midfielder tried to round him. Advertisement
